limitations: Coverage is a selected, uneven documentation sample, not a comparable performance ranking or causal design. Joplin B-13-MS-29-0001 is supplemental QPR evidence outside the national F31 snapshot.
Q1 contains execution date and may be partial. No interpolation to exact 12/36/60-month anniversaries.
QPR activity lists can omit unchanged activities. Listed/matched categories are not complete category totals.
Ratios compare same-scope reported cumulative quantities at the same reporting horizon. Later revisions and program income remain in source values.
F31 flows and QPR cumulative figures are different vintages and are not spliced. No national/Texas concatenation.
A changing obligation or allocated activity budget can change a ratio even as expenditure rises. Above-100% values are flags, not capped.
Unapproved report amounts and five unrecertified whole-grant allocation outcomes are withheld. Houston award-relative horizon is unavailable; other effective-quarter labels are provisional.

source_definitions.supports: Allocated activity budget, distinct from obligations; budgets may include program income.
QPRs may omit activities; expenditures differ from drawdowns; report revisions/approval matter.
